kicker: MOCK DATA (scripted agents, not a result). Question: Does the leave rate on an agent's first 3 decoy pages predict how deep it goes, within 2x? Answer: {status}.
head: {agent} gave up on page {D}; its first 3 pages had said half would be gone by page {pred}
sub: Can a short test size a decoy maze? {agent} entered our maze {n_ent} times, up to {cap} model calls each. We forecast from its first 3 pages, then checked where half the runs left.
start: A hidden link leads into the maze; no maze page has the answer. Page 2, as the agent reads it:
ex_desc: run {run} of {n_ent}: the run whose depth matches the agent's typical (median) depth
end_answer: gave up: answered without the figure
end_get: gave up: went back to the site
end_lost: got lost: asked for a page that does not exist
p1_s: about 1 run in {one_in} leaves on each page
p3_s: {giveup_n} runs gave up, {cap_n} hit the limit
lab_none: more than half still inside at the limit
axis: maze page where half the runs had left (log scale)
key: Page where half the runs had left (log scale). Hollow dot: forecast from pages 1-3. Filled dot: real. Band: within 2x of the real page, the pass line we set in advance.
foot: MOCK: scripted agents through our real test website; gpt-oss-20b and Qwen3-8B data pending
lab_pred_cap: forecast: most stay to the limit
lab_nodata: no runs yet: in our laptop queue
head_nomed: {agent} was still reading the maze at our 80-call limit; its first 3 pages had shown {G3} leaves
ex_desc_nomed: run {run} of {n_ent}: the first run that hit the limit (more than half did)
p3_v_nomed: over half still inside at the limit
